description: Run GraphQL queries and mutations against a Beebole time-tracking account.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Beebole API key sent with the apikey header. In Beebole, open the initials button at the bottom of the left sidebar, then open API Key to copy or reset it: https://beebole.com/help/api/introduction.

actions.name: execute_graphql
actions.description: Execute a JSON-friendly Beebole GraphQL query or mutation against the connected account.

query.description: The GraphQL query or mutation document to execute.

variables.description: GraphQL variables keyed by variable name.

operationName.description: The GraphQL operation name to execute when the document defines multiple operations.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for executing a Beebole GraphQL operation.

data.description: The GraphQL data payload returned by Beebole.

line.description: The one-based source line for the GraphQL error.

column.description: The one-based source column for the GraphQL error.

locations.description: Source locations associated with the GraphQL error.

path.description: GraphQL response path entries associated with the error.

items.description: A GraphQL error returned by Beebole.

outputSchema.description: The raw Beebole GraphQL response envelope.
